design: The five hypotheses preregistered in PRD section 3, decided from the curve, the non-regression rows and the quarantine report of this run. A failed hypothesis is published as failed.

rows.claim: held-out accuracy after round N exceeds round 0 by more than the seed spread, every seed
rows.rule: accuracy(round N) - accuracy(round 0) > the round-0 spread across seeds, for every seed

rows.claim: random controls do not rise beyond seed spread
rows.rule: for each random control and each seed, accuracy(round N) - accuracy(round 0) <= the round-0 spread

rows.claim: the plain-store arm is flat across rounds
rows.note: flat by construction: it is scored once per seed and cannot learn
rows.rule: the plain-store accuracy is identical at every round, for every seed

rows.claim: quarantine recall on planted wrong edges >= 0.7 with false-quarantine rate <= 0.1
rows.rule: recall on planted wrong edges >= 0.7 for every seed, and false-quarantine rate <= 0.1 where defined

rows.claim: net regressions on previously-correct held-out questions <= 2% per round
rows.rule: newly_broken / correct <= 0.02 in the worst round after round 0, full arm
